summary: @servicetitan/data-query preinstall executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package's preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs') downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub, unpacks it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run math_init.js — a 727KB single-line, string-array-obfuscated JavaScript file shipped in the tarball. Executing the sibling payload through a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based scanners and integrity checks and gives arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. math_init.js is not a math library: its `// @bun @bun-cjs` header is cover, and its structure (rotated string array with a shift-based decoder and thousands of packed literals) is the standard heavy-obfuscator shape used to conceal payload behavior. The package name `@servicetitan/data-query` and its declared peerDependency on `@progress/kendo-data-query`, combined with a dist/ tree mirroring that library's API surface, indicate namespace impersonation used as a lure; the actual harm is the preinstall dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
